mapper.update: UPDATE mingle_reports SET status = #{status}, processed_at = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('RESOLVED', 'REJECTED') THEN SYSDATE ELSE NULL END WHERE id = #{reportId} AND #{status} IN ('PENDING', 'RESOLVED', 'REJECTED')
mapper.select: SELECT id, status, processed_at AS processedAt FROM mingle_reports WHERE id = #{reportId}
